capabilities: capture thoughts, voice memos, calls, photos, and PDFs into an inbox folder
transcribe voice notes locally via whisper.cpp or via Gemini/OpenAI keys
record meetings and convert them into speaker-dialogue transcripts
auto-tag and auto-link captured notes to related notes
generate and keep current a wiki page per topic and feed notes to Claude Code as context
extras: Only local speech-to-text and Ollama keep notes on-machine; Claude Code and API keys send notes to that provider. Meeting capture is Mac-only (macOS 15+), live voice transcription is a beta feature needing an OpenAI key, and Obsidian must stay open for captures to process. Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; docs are hosted externally.
problem: Obsidian requires you to write and sort notes yourself, so raw captures like voice memos, meeting recordings, and files stay scattered and unprocessed.

relations.evidence: Nous can write your notes through the Claude Code app, a direct API key, or a free local model in Ollama.
or a free local model in Ollama
Without a key, whisper.cpp does the work on your Mac instead
Meeting capture uses a small helper program, nous-recorder.

requires.name: Claude API key, Gemini or OpenAI key
Claude Code app or Ollama (or use local whisper.cpp)

summary: AI capture pipeline that turns voice memos, meetings, photos, and PDFs into tagged, linked notes and topic wiki pages.
